context: Evaluates correct error handling for spprof's start() and stop() functions. Checks that the candidate catches ValueError for invalid interval_ms, RuntimeError for double-start, and RuntimeError for double-stop, with appropriate messages printed.

checklist.name: ValueError on invalid interval
checklist.description: ValueError is caught when interval_ms < 1 (e.g., interval_ms=0) and 'Error: invalid interval' is printed

checklist.name: RuntimeError on double-start
checklist.description: RuntimeError is caught when start() is called while profiling is already active and 'Error: already running' is printed

checklist.name: RuntimeError on double-stop
checklist.description: RuntimeError is caught when stop() is called when profiling is not active and 'Error: not running' is printed

checklist.name: Profile returned on success
checklist.description: safe_profile(10) returns the valid Profile object from the successful stop() call
